name: vagabonde-field-ops-beta2
description: Repo-root build entry. The app itself lives in vite-app/.

scripts.//: Cloudflare Workers Builds runs from the repo root with no root-directory setting, so the build reaches down into the app. `npm ci` rather than `install` so the lockfile is honoured exactly and a CI build can't quietly pick up a different dependency version than the one tested here.
scripts.build: npm --prefix vite-app ci && npm --prefix vite-app run build
scripts.//deploy: Local deploy safeguard, not CI: a red test stops the deploy on the one path that actually ships. Deploys are run by hand from this machine (wrangler CLI), so this is the gate. Direct `npx wrangler deploy` still bypasses it, and Supabase Edge Functions deploy separately via the supabase CLI.
scripts.deploy: npm test && npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
